name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump’s Deal With Russia Inflames Ukraine War He Vowed to End
changes.summary: The Ukrainian president’s defiant decision to continue attacking Russian refineries underscores President Trump’s inability to end a war he had promised to resolve.

changes.title: Zelensky Says Ukraine Will Resume Russian Refinery Strikes, Defying Trump
changes.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky expressed overt frustration with the United States in an interview with The Financial Times. He had paused the strikes to comply with a demand from the United States.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump's campaign tour continues as Republicans rally voters ahead of midterms, Ukraine faces limited access to Starshield technology, Houthi rebels hit Saudi oil company building.

changes.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries as relations with Trump sour
changes.summary: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over amid deepening tensions with Washington.

changes.title: Ukraine resumes strikes on energy targets, saying Russia never stopped its attacks
changes.summary: The tense alliance between Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and President Trump is nearing a new low point. After days of bitter back-and-forth between the two leaders, Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian energy targets. Trump had demanded an "energy ceasefire" this past Sunday between the two. Russia never stopped its.

changes.title: Ukraine less reliant on U.S. as Trump-Zelenskyy rift deepens, former ambassador says
changes.summary: For perspective on the tensions between President Trump and Ukrainian President Zelenskyy, Amna Nawaz spoke with former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor. He's now a distinguished fellow at the Atlantic Council.

changes.title: Senators Demand Investigation Into Ukraine Satellite Disruption
changes.summary: Republicans joined Democrats in calling on the Pentagon’s inspector general to look into whether the Trump administration was responsible for the interruption.

changes.title: How U.S. Support to Ukraine Has Evolved Under Trump
changes.summary: President Trump’s latest push to end the war in Ukraine has raised questions about the future of U.S. support.

changes.title: Why Russia Sees a Window to Bomb Ukraine Into Submission This Winter
changes.summary: Moscow is not winning on the battlefield. Instead, it is seizing an opening to inflict immense human suffering in Ukrainian cities.
